title: Farragut ENT
description: farragutent.com Farragut ENT & Allergy is an independent medical practice in Farragut, Knoxville, Tennessee, offering ear, nose and throat care, allergy treatment, audiology and facial plastic surgery. Founded around 2013, it operates six locations across East Tennessee under three brands: Farragut ENT & Allergy, the Balance & Hearing Institute, and the Knoxville Center for Facial Plastic Surgery. Its flagship specialty is balloon sinuplasty, a minimally invasive in office sinus procedure with a 94 percent success rate, and it is recognized as a National Center of Excellence where other doctors train. The team includes board certified surgeons like Dr. Clyde Mathison, the area's only fellowship trained facial plastic surgeon, Dr. Mark Gurley and veteran otologist Dr. William Merwin, plus five audiologists fitting hearing aids and cochlear implants. Services span in office CT scans, allergy testing with shots and drops, Eustachian tube balloon dilation, tinnitus and balance testing.
